name: high_priest_of_kilmorph
description: a High Priest of Kilmorph (Fall from Heaven), a stout dwarf with a long white braided beard and bushy white brows, a tall ornate gold crown set with an orange gem, a heavy grey stone-and-gold mantle with large rune-carved shoulder plates over a brown robe with gold trim and an orange gem clasp, gold boots, and a tall golden runed staff topped with a glowing fiery orange crystal between grey stone wings, held upright in his LEFT hand (screen-right); his RIGHT hand (screen-left) is an empty fist at his side under the mantle
hands: the crystal-topped golden staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist at his side on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the white beard jolting, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left from under the grey mantle, the staff arm thrown up and out holding the crystal-topped golden staff)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the golden staff with its orange crystal tilting, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped golden staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head with its gold crown droops, the golden staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal end of the golden staff resting on the ground, his empty right arm hanging under the grey mantle
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the golden staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the heavy grey mantle flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the gold crown still on his head and the white beard on his chest; the crystal-topped golden staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the grey mantle spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the grey mantle and white beard settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crystal-topped golden staff on the ground beside him
